versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update with new features, improved docs, and CI integration.

- New "self-test" command for built-in testing.
- Improved documentation (new README, simpler SKILL.md, CI usage examples).
- CI scripts added for automated checking and product verification.
- "skill-card.md" file removed.
- Enhanced CLI help, snapshot, diff, and watch commands.
- Refined glob filtering and event detection.

Initial release of File System Watcher.

- Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies; works on any OS (Windows, macOS, Linux)
- Polling-based file watcher: detects file/directory creates, modifications, and deletions
- Three core commands: watch (continuous monitoring), once (snapshot), diff (compare snapshots)
- Flexible filtering: event types, glob/regex patterns, and noise ignore options
- Outputs JSON-formatted snapshots for easy integration and offline comparison
- Includes quiet mode, max event count, and usage examples for CI/dev workflows
